audience: Local couples and groups eating out midweek, plus a lunch trade from the surrounding studios and offices

services.name: Neapolitan pizza
services.description: Twelve-inch pizzas proved for 48 hours and fired for 70 seconds in a wood oven. Margherita £9.50, Diavola £12, Marinara £8.

services.name: Small plates
services.description: Cicchetti-style plates to share before pizza — nduja arancini, burrata with grilled peach, marinated anchovies. £5 to £8 each.

services.name: Set lunch
services.description: One small plate and one pizza for £14, served Tuesday to Friday between noon and 3pm.

services.name: Private hire
services.description: The back room seats 24 and can be booked for an evening with a set menu agreed in advance.

differentiators: Dough made daily with a starter kept going since the restaurant opened
Wood oven built on site by a bricklayer from Naples
Wine list is entirely Italian and entirely under £40 a bottle
Kitchen closes at 10pm because the whole team eats together afterwards
tone: Direct and a little wry. Confident about the food without describing it as a journey. Short sentences.
goals: Get people to book a table for midweek evenings, which are quieter than weekends
Make the set lunch obvious to people working nearby
Take private-hire enquiries for the back room
